integrity: The supplied C11 and Python standard-library programs independently enumerate all candidate words, and exact complete optimum inventory is embedded. No claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification of binary cyclic seven-window Hamming-radius-one covering cycles, up to length 22 only; exact census, not all-order theorem. The minimum length 22 was previously tabulated; the count, group orbits, weight and multiplicity profiles are the proposed contribution. Historical priority and independent review remain open.
title: Complete classification of minimum-length binary radius-one covering cycles at order seven
